nodes.norm_label: u2 — a fully funded claim on a dated practice outcome
nodes.rationale: Recommended as the full-world direction if finite positions and arbitrage are central, because it lets one profit from forecasting a practice's future without loving it and lose money while correctly recognizing its human importance. Costs: a bounded outcome, expiry/roll mechanics, settlement authority, and price narrowed toward measurable activity. Unadopted.
nodes.source_location: ### U2 — A fully funded claim on a dated practice outcome

nodes.label: U2 Bounded Payout Threshold K
nodes.rationale: g(L_T) = 100 × min(L_T/K, 1). The illustrative K = 10,000 fails the LETTER baseline — 416 sends/week saturates the cap around week 25, after which all later changes leave payout unchanged. The saturation example demonstrates why the threshold cannot be an invisible tuning knob.

nodes.label: U2 Settlement Gate
nodes.rationale: A real statistical truth and a contract's administratively eligible outcome are different. Giving the clearing trust the private author-known true count would eliminate precisely the observation problem the fictional institution is meant to face.

nodes.label: Price the Decline in an Appreciating Numeraire
nodes.norm_label: price the decline in an appreciating numeraire
nodes.rationale: Speed, certainty, immediacy as the yardstick, so romance did not get cheaper — the yardstick got heavier. Recorded as llm-proposed and not adopted at the time, but the eventual STANDARD RETURN answer takes exactly this shape.
nodes.source_location: ## The backing layer sharpens this question (2026-09-15)

nodes.label: Double Counting of Prevalence
nodes.rationale: Prevalence would feed the fundamental and the weight, so the same decline is counted twice, in opposite directions. This is why the final answer makes float a separate quantity from the index weight.
nodes.source_location: ## Why the reviews split on it — Refuse the unit

nodes.label: Equal-Weighted Headline Plus Prevalence-Weighted Secondary
nodes.rationale: Claude's compromise is the only one letting both answers coexist. The spread between the two becomes the interesting output rather than a methodological embarrassment: is the decline concentrated in practices already abandoned, or broad-based? The institution does not have to interpret it, only print it.
nodes.source_location: ## The proposal that dissolves the disagreement

nodes.label: Equal Weighting (Refuse the Unit)
nodes.rationale: Claude, Kimi and Grok object on double counting, fabrication, and signal damping — cap-weighting shrinks the weight of decliners so the index would fall less than its average constituent, the opposite of what the work shows. Equal weighting also carries an institutional position: a research institution that declines to rank human experiences by importance. Kimi adds that no capital tracks LONGING, so size should not determine weight.
nodes.source_location: ## Why the reviews split on it — Refuse the unit

nodes.label: Float Is Not the Index Weight
nodes.norm_label: float is not the index weight
nodes.rationale: The headline index is equal-weighted so prevalence cannot feed both the fundamental and the weight. Float is outstanding BEARER BONDs, estimated rather than counted because a bearer instrument has no register.

nodes.label: Footprint Weighting
nodes.rationale: GLM's variant: practising population × frequency, re-measured annually with buffer bands, tagged MODELED, on the precedent of fundamental indexing. The annual re-measurement makes the benchmark of human longing always update one year behind the world that is killing it.
nodes.source_location: ## Why the reviews split on it — Define the unit

nodes.label: Practice Unit and Practice Capitalization
nodes.rationale: Qwen's standardized unit per security with Practice Capitalization = Market Price × Modelled Practice Units, capped at 10–15%. Its good property: as a practice becomes rare, price per unit may rise while units outstanding fall, so the aggregate declines even as the security rallies — a thing can appreciate as an object of longing while the total value of the practice collapses.
nodes.source_location: ## Why the reviews split on it — Define the unit

nodes.label: STANDARD RETURN (SR) Numeraire
nodes.rationale: A fixed basket of AI-mediated acts valued by what the basket gives back. Chosen because it is countable, so float and positioning survive, and it appreciates, so the decline needs no drift coefficient. It satisfies both constraints: the backing is not the numeraire, and BEARER BOND and BLIND TRUST share the unit.

nodes.label: Total Attentional Float
nodes.rationale: Gemini's third route: keep a size measure but define it as the total time and frequency people physically spend on the practice.
nodes.source_location: ## Why the reviews split on it

nodes.label: U1 — A Quoted Reference With No Owned Share
nodes.norm_label: u1 — a quoted reference with no owned share
nodes.rationale: Makes the institution's act of pricing the central fiction and preserves the viewer's distance, but gives up a literal finite-position market: no float, no open interest, no short squeeze. Recommended as the smaller publication rehearsal. Unadopted.
nodes.source_location: ### U1 — A quoted reference with no owned share

nodes.label: U3 — A Transferable Entitlement to Finite Support Capacity
nodes.norm_label: u3 — a transferable entitlement to finite support capacity
nodes.rationale: Asks which conditions people fund so a practice can remain possible, and gives a real float from unredeemed capacity. Not recommended as the first branch because it shifts attention from research about disappearance toward who controls support, and adds a market-to-practice loop. Unadopted.
nodes.source_location: ### U3 — A transferable entitlement to finite support capacity

nodes.label: Q-004 — What is one unit of a LONGING security?
nodes.norm_label: q-004 — what is one unit of a longing security?

nodes.label: The Denominator Problem
nodes.rationale: If the traded good and the thing backing it are made of the same substance, both sides of the ratio move together and the quote does not move at all. A price only exists once the two are separable and separately named, so the numeraire cannot itself be love, understanding, or trust.
nodes.source_location: ## The backing layer sharpens this question (2026-09-15)

nodes.label: Branch Selection Rule
nodes.rationale: Do not combine the unit of one branch, the capitalization of another, and the squeeze of a third without explicitly designing the connecting contracts. Keep the behavior series available independently of price under every branch.

nodes.label: Constructed Versus Asserted Indices
nodes.rationale: This question decides whether LONGING's indices are constructed or merely asserted, and how much fiction must be manufactured: a practice-unit universe requires inventing a plausible number for every security, and every one of those numbers is a place where the artist's hand can be found.
